## 3dslibris 3.1.2

This update fixes images that showed as a black box, makes formatting inside tables show up, and adds a text alignment setting with real justified text.

### New

- [#138](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/issues/138): new `text alignment` setting with three modes. `editorial` (default) follows the book's own styles, `left` aligns everything to the left, and `justify` stretches lines to both margins. The last line of each paragraph is never stretched, and centred or right-aligned text such as titles and poems keeps its alignment. You can also override it per book from the book settings. Applies to EPUB, MOBI and FB2.

### Fixes and improvements

- [#169](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/issues/169): large images, especially progressive JPEGs, no longer show up as a black box. 
- [#180](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/issues/180): `<br>` styled with `display: block` no longer adds an extra blank line.
- [#180](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/issues/180) / [#179](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/issues/179): text inside tables now keeps line breaks, bold and italic, including bold or italic set through CSS classes. Tables are still shown as plain text without cell boxes or borders.

### Downloads

- `3dslibris.cia` or `3dslibris.3dsx` for normal use.
- `3dslibris-sdmc.zip`: runtime files for Homebrew Launcher installs; use with the `.3dsx` download.
- Debug builds (`3dslibris-debug.cia` / `3dslibris-debug.3dsx`) and `3dslibris-source.tar.gz` are also included.

Thanks to everyone trying the builds and reporting issues, and special thanks to @EmbersFlying for the test file that made the image and table fixes possible. You can support the project with a ⭐ on GitHub or [a coffee](https://ko-fi.com/rigle).
